title: Service health
idea: Service health: Current availability and freshness precede measured service traces
audience: People who need to monitor service within a dashboard surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its monitor service priority and explicit commitment contract: Missing telemetry never displays healthy by default
navigation: Service health keeps the current monitor service context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Current availability and freshness precede measured service traces
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to monitor service; operators diagnose actual systems
composition.priority: Missing telemetry never displays healthy by default

imagery.role: Support the actual monitor service context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Text status and accessible tables accompany charts
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the service health structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no monitor service content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Missing telemetry never displays healthy by default
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized monitor service content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Missing telemetry never displays healthy by default
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active monitor service context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
